who_we_are.heading:
Less intimidation,
more confidence.
who_we_are.text:
At FORGE, transformation goes beyond physique. We help you build  a healthier lifestyle.

Our No Pressure Space gives you the freedom to train however you like: Choose an Personal Training, join a Semi-Private Group Training, or rent a Private Gym for an exclusive session in our space.

Your body. Your strength. Your journey.

commitment.photo_alt: Weight plates and equipment stored along the studio wall
commitment.heading:
A 3 month commitment.
A Lifetime change.
commitment.text:
At FORGE, we help you achieve goals that matter, like building strength and improving your quality of life. Through consistency, you can shape your body and build a stronger connection with yourself.

Our 3-month commitment gives you the time and support to build a routine, stay accountable, and create meaningful progress.

our_space.heading: A space to call yours.
our_space.text: FORGE’s studio is designed to make you feel at home, with an intimate, welcoming space in the heart of the Fraser Valley.

meet.heading: Meet the person helping forge your future.
meet.heading_mobile:
Meet the person forging
your future.
meet.text:
Gabriela has spent over a decade teaching Yoga and now has became a Certified Personal Trainer, combined with years of gym experience and a passion for helping people feel confident in their bodies.

Her approach goes beyond building a better physique. She builds confidence, discipline, resilience, and a better quality of life through sustainable results.

No miracle diets. No shortcuts. Just balanced training, consistency, and a good dose of humour.
